title: free-for-creators category file
description: Schema for data/<slug>.json. Editor aid — authoritative validation lives in scripts/build_readme.py.

category.description: Human-readable category name, used as the README heading.

category_zh.description: Chinese category name, used as the README.zh-CN.md heading.

description_zh.description: Chinese one-line description of the category.

url.description: Canonical landing page. HTTPS only, no affiliate or tracking params, no URL shorteners.

description.description: What it is, in one line. No pipe characters.

description_zh.description: Chinese description. Optional — the zh README falls back to English.

license.description: License name, e.g. 'CC0', 'Pixabay Content License', 'Various (per item)'.

attribution.description: Is credit/attribution mandatory for free use?

monetization.description: Can it be used in monetized/commercial content for free?

signup.description: Is an account needed to download?

notes.description: Optional caveats shown in italics after the description.

notes_zh.description: Chinese caveats. Optional — the zh README falls back to English.

skip_linkcheck.description: Set true only when CI cannot check the URL (e.g. login walls). Justify in the PR.
